'''Live Long and Prosper''' is the 32nd virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on September 1, 2017. The set consists of 66 cards. This set is part of the ''Enterprise Block'' consisting of cards from [[Broken Bow]], [[Pre-Warp Pack]], [[Live Long and Prosper (expansion)|Live Long and Prosper]], [[Cold Front (expansion)|Cold Front]], and [[Enterprise Collection Remastered (expansion)|Enterprise Collection Remastered]] expansion sets.

==Type Breakdown==
* 1 [[:Category:Artifact (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Artifact]]
* 1 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
* 6 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
* 9 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
* 11 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
* 1 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
* 30 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (2 Non-Aligned, 2 Romulan, 4 Starfleet, and 26 Vulcan)
* 4 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (4 Vulcan)
* 1 [[:Category:Tactic (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Tactic]]
* 2 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.
